spec.label: L5_PASSIVE_SURFACE_SPEC_V1
spec.scope: BTC15m / Polymarket. Not promoted to any other cohort or venue.

base_quantity.value: base lot 100 shares; working sizes median 24-38
base_quantity.evidence: 1,142 chain-proven parents, 0 receipts missing: 100 is the dominant mode and appears in EVERY probability regime (0.131-0.301)
base_quantity.confidence: HIGH that 100 is a real lot; MEDIUM on the working range
base_quantity.unknown: executed_qty is a LOWER BOUND on order size -- a 200 that filled 100 and cancelled is indistinguishable from a 100

sizing_function.value: NOT dollar-scaled. Share count is the controlled quantity.
sizing_function.evidence: cv(executed_qty) = 0.797 against cv(notional) = 1.212 -- a probability-scaled notional rule would make notional the TIGHTER quantity and it is 52% more dispersed
sizing_function.unknown: why 100 is used 2.3x more at p>0.90 (0.301) than at 0.70-0.90 (0.131). Frequency varies with regime even though the lot does not.

inventory_conditioning.confidence: LOW -- no clean scaling law is supported
inventory_conditioning.unknown: whether price skew (rather than size) carries the conditioning

simultaneous_levels.evidence: 290 distinct same-outcome parents within 5s at different prices; tick gaps 1 (x113), 2 (x57), 3 (x37); median separation 3s
simultaneous_levels.confidence: HIGH that ladders exist; MEDIUM on the depth
simultaneous_levels.unknown: levels that never executed are invisible, so the ladder's full width is UNOBSERVABLE_OR_UNRESOLVED

level_is_not_size_specific.value: the 100-lot is NOT specifically a ladder rung
level_is_not_size_specific.evidence: 0.3674 of 100s sit in a ladder against 0.3700 of all others

two_sided.value: YES, but not tick-simultaneous. Both outcomes are worked on a ~18s median cadence.
two_sided.evidence: 1,015 opposite-outcome parent pairs: 3.8% within 1s, 20.2% within 5s, 44.1% within 15s, 64.0% within 30s, 79.9% within 60s; median dt 18s
two_sided.note: the implied pair is cheaper the closer the two sides are in time -- share below 1.00 falls 0.769 (same second) -> 0.644 (5s) -> 0.565 (60s), with a median of 0.99 at every horizon

refresh_cadence.value: a new parent roughly every 8s in a market
refresh_cadence.evidence: median gap 8s, p25 3s, p75 21s; 16.0% within 1s, 38.4% within 5s

persistence.value: execution-lifetime LOWER BOUND p50 2s, p90 6s, max 28s
persistence.evidence: 11.0-11.2% of parents execute at more than one timestamp
persistence.confidence: HIGH as a lower bound, NONE as an order lifetime
persistence.unknown: when an order was submitted or cancelled is not on the chain. This is not persistence and must never be read as rest duration.

withdrawal_conditions.evidence: none -- cancellations are not observable in any source held here

tte_dependence.value: matched economics concentrate late: TTE <=60s earned 258.7 -> 649.3 bp/$ TRAIN -> OOS while >700s earned 48.2 -> -11.0
tte_dependence.confidence: MEDIUM -- historical, and explicitly NOT a gate

reversal_relationship.value: reversals, not drift, generate matched pairs
reversal_relationship.evidence: 0 reversals -> +14.8 bp/$ OOS, 6+ -> +93.9; L5's own venue runs 3.49 reversals/min at a 1.0-tick spread

recycling_clock.evidence: prospective residual clock: 0.00/0.00/0.00/0.40/0.60/1.00 at 5/15/30/60/120/300s, n=6 episodes
recycling_clock.confidence: LOW (tiny n) and the early marks are CENSORED by a 22.2s median public-feed lag
recycling_clock.unknown: whether the 5-30s zeros are real or publication-lag artifacts -- they must not be read literally
